result.summary: Found several visual/layout issues, mostly related to loading placeholders and horizontal scroll cutoffs.

issues.description: Tokumaru Ramen Bar image shows a loading spinner overlay instead of the actual food image having finished loading
issues.suggestion: Ensure images are fully loaded before rendering the card, or add a skeleton loader that resolves properly

issues.description: Third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the edge of the screen
issues.suggestion: Add partial-card peeking indication or ensure consistent card spacing so the cutoff looks intentional for scroll affordance

issues.description: Category filter row (Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge showing a partial pill button
issues.suggestion: Add fade/gradient overlay or ensure equal padding to indicate scrollability clearly

issues.description: Notification bell icon has a red dot but no count, giving ambiguous unread status
issues.suggestion: Add a number badge or ensure dot is only shown when there are unread notifications

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' appears truncated without ellipsis styling consistency
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text truncation with ellipsis and ensure minimum card width to reduce cutoff appearance
